name: proxy-shopping
description: Buy at cash-only or unsupported shops with BTC through a proxy shopper and a 2-of-3 escrow, or earn as a proxy shopper
long_description: An MCP server for the proxy-shopping P2P network (Nostr). Buy from shops that take only cash or payments you cannot use: a local proxy shopper buys and ships, and you pay BTC into a per-order 2-of-3 escrow (you, the shopper, an escrow) with timelocks. Find offers, request and validate a quote (rate check, recomputed escrow address, timelocks), fund, confirm receipt, dispute, countersign the escrow's ruling, accept a refund, or take the funds back after the timelock. Tools that move money act only with confirm: true. Or earn: become_shopper plans an always-online shopper node that buys for remote users for a fee, registry_entry writes the file for getting listed. The public network ps-main uses BTC signet (test coins) and is new. The key and orders are kept in the data directory (default ~/.proxy-shopping-mcp).

network.title: Network
network.description: ps-main (public Nostr relays, BTC signet) or lab (the local docker compose lab at http://localhost:8888)

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Where this agent's key (a BIP39 mnemonic, created on first run) and its orders are kept. Keep it and back it up: it controls the escrow of open orders.
